title: MakeItBeauty connector manifest (v0)
description: Declares a data connector: how it authenticates, what snapshot shape it produces, and how often snapshots refresh. Connectors are trusted code shipped via reviewed PRs — unlike (future) community components, which are sandboxed.

auth.description: none: public API. api_key: user pastes a key once. oauth_pkce: public-client OAuth (preferred). oauth_confidential: requires our client secret — add sparingly, each one expands the vault.

scopes.description: Upstream scopes requested; keep minimal. Shown verbatim on the connect-consent screen.

snapshotTtlSeconds.description: Snapshot cache TTL. Served stale-while-revalidate: an upstream failure never fails a render.

snapshotSchema.description: JSON Schema of the snapshot this connector produces. Prefer the normalized shapes (timeseries, counter, item_list, profile) so components stay portable across connectors.
